text:
Maya (CS Ops): quick ask — can we add a webhook from Enablement that fires when a customer completes training? Need it to create a CRM activity, attach free-text feedback, and bump healthscore +10 for NPS >= 9.
Diego (Eng Backend): ok — public endpoint on ops-api or send into events-queue?
Maya (CS Ops): ops-api preferred so we can map immediately to account owner. endpoint would be /webhooks/enablement
Mina (Product): mapping notes: training_id -> onboarding_playbook, nps->health_delta, feedback->crm.note. Also we should include training metadata (hours, instructor) when available.
Sam (CS Manager): want a backfill for last 90 days and an opt-out flag per account if legal/regulatory.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-1892 for enablement webhook work — assignee Diego.
Diego (Eng Backend): proposing payload + headers — signature + idempotency. sample below:
```
POST /webhooks/enablement
Headers: X-RW-Signature: sha256=..., X-RW-Idempotency: <id>
{
  "account_id": "acct_123",
  "user_id": "user_987",
  "training_id": "onboard-2026-q1",
  "training_name": "Redwood Onboarding",
  "nps": 9,
  "feedback": "Loved the live workshop — very practical",
  "duration_minutes": 75,
  "instructor": "J. Lee",
  "event_ts": "2026-03-21T16:00:00Z"
}
```
Diego (Eng Backend): idempotency_key suggestion = sha256(account_id + event_ts + training_id). Retry policy: 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1m, 4m, 16m). We'll verify X-RW-Signature using shared secret.
Maya (CS Ops): thanks. For healthscore changes can we soft-gate the +10: first tag account with `enablement.received` and only apply +10 after 14d if no churn flags triggered? That will avoid noisy immediate scoring.
Mina (Product): agree on soft-gate. Also add a feature-flag to allow immediate scoring for a canary org (org_id: 654321). We'll want metrics: delta in renewal risk and NPS distribution.
Diego (Eng Backend): will add feature flag `ff.enable_enablement_healthscore` and canary to org 654321. Also adding admin backfill endpoint: `/admin/backfill/enablement?days=90&dry_run=true`. Backfill will use idempotency to avoid double-applying.
Sam (CS Manager): good. For backfill, please include owner mapping in the CSV export so CS can prioritize outreach.
Maya (CS Ops): I'll prepare the backfill list and sample owners CSV. Also want an audit note on the account when webhook is received: who submitted it (user_id) + training_name.
Diego (Eng Backend): noted — we'll write CRM activity type `Enablement: completion` and include `meta.source=enablement` and `meta.idempotency_key`.
Mina (Product): small ask — include `training_version` when present so we can track curriculum changes effect on health.
Diego (Eng Backend): will add `training_version` optional field. Security: we will rotate signing secret quarterly and support `X-RW-Signature-V2` header during rotation window.
Maya (CS Ops): timeline?
Diego (Eng Backend): PR by EOD Thursday, canary rollout next Tuesday to org 654321, metrics watch 7 days, then full enable if no regressions. Backfill dry-run the day before canary, full backfill after approval.
Sam (CS Manager): please surface a small sha256 sample in the PR so ops can verify signature locally.
Diego (Eng Backend): will include a test script and sample webhook in the PR.
Maya (CS Ops): thanks all — tagging @Diego when PR is ready please drop link here. I'll coordinate with CS to prepare the 90-day backfill owners list and opt-out exceptions. :thumbsup:
